title: The lint slot cap gets its review fixes, and test_install_src.sh stops failing under load
why: Lane lane-lint-parallel-cap (PR #1843) left five review findings unfiled (lane, 02:35 CST Nov 8): (1) merge/test_lane_lint.py:621-640 checks that the hung stub died, not that its slot freed; (2) merge/test_lane_lint.py:35 says a case skips on Windows, but none does; (3) note lint-slot-windows-hung-pipe in docs/debts/notes.md should say the wait is forever only once every slot holds a hung run; (4) debt lint-slot-scope-unpinned should add that the merge's own lint (merge.py:1843) runs beside N lane lints; (5) hooks/guard_core.py try_lock_fd names two lock copies but gives no reason they stay. Also measured: with 8 lints at once on 4 CPUs, 3 of 8 FAIL falsely in hooks/test_install_src.sh caseF4/F6.
note: Fix: (1) assert the slot frees; (2) make the comment true or add the skip; (3) and (4) rewrite the note and the debt in place; (5) give the reason or keep one copy (rule building-one-home-per-capability); find why caseF4/F6 fail under load and fix the cause, never by a longer wait alone. Built as a follow-up from #1843's head in lane lane-lint-parallel-cap (coordinator, 02:36 CST Nov 8). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Title and slug by triage. Filed 02:37 CST Nov 8. Ready as #1888 (f7cd74df6), Merge after: #1843, with runner 8 (lane, 04:28 CST Nov 8). Cause of the caseF4/F6 false FAILs: hooks/test_install_src.sh wrote stderr to fixed /tmp paths shared by parallel runs; 8 copies at once failed 1 of 8 before and 0 of 8 after (one run each).
